target.statement: RealCompo achieves a CLIP Score of 0.334 on 3K COCO validation prompts, outperforming Stable Diffusion v1.4 (0.307), SD v2.1 (0.321), SDXL (0.322), GLIGEN (0.301), and LMD+ (0.298).
target.dataset: COCO validation set (3K randomly selected prompts)

compute.basis: Generating 3K images with a training-free composition of two diffusion models (SD v1.5 + GLIGEN) requires GPU acceleration; on CPU, each image would take minutes, making the full evaluation infeasible within a few hours.

blockers: Requires GPT-4 API for layout generation (closed-source, paid)
Needs GPU for reasonable runtime (CPU generation of 3K images is too slow)
Code repository may not include exact evaluation scripts or pre-generated layouts
title: RealCompo: Balancing Realism and Compositionality Improves Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
